dedupe_keys.name: fathom global flood map flood catastrophe models and fathomdem terrain data

description: Fathom has provided flood risk data since 2013. Its Global Flood Map gives flood hazard for any region worldwide for pluvial, fluvial and coastal flooding, as depths and risk scores, and it also sells flood catastrophe models, an event response product and FathomDEM+ global terrain data. Coverage: global at about 30 m (1 arcsecond) resolution, built on its FABDEM-based terrain, downscaled to 10 m where regional data allow; flood depths for return periods from 5 to 1,000 years, defended and undefended views, relative risk and risk category scores, water surface elevations, and a Climate Dynamics option for any future year and climate scenario up to 2100; metadata layers on the factors affecting certainty; regional enhancements such as a Japan flood map and a UK flood catastrophe model; FathomDEM+ combines the machine-learning FathomDEM with a large LiDAR database at about 30 m and 10 m. Format and access: API, web portal, direct provision and platform partners; licensable for the whole planet, regions or single polygons; sample data and demos on request. Licence: commercial; not read. Caveats: prices and file formats are not stated on the pages read; accuracy claims cite a benchmarking study (Guth et al., Remote Sensing) that was not read. Simulation uses: flood depth and return period layers for hazard exposure and fragility-based damage of roads, rail, power and water assets, and climate-conditioned scenarios for adaptation planning. Related records: the open GloFAS and EFAS river forecasts (data-glofas, data-efas-european-flood-awareness-system).
